Before wiring these into the site, open each sourceUrl once, click Download, and either (a) hotlink the resulting images-*.{unsplash,pexels,pixabay}.com CDN URL, or (b) download the file and add it to this directory, recording the final filename below. All three sources offer free, royalty-free licenses that permit commercial/website use without required attribution.
